sentences.en: We often think of the media we consume as food for the mind.
sentences.zh: 我们常把所接触的媒体视为精神食粮。

sentences.en: The right books, the uplifting films, the inspiring podcasts,
sentences.zh: 好书、励志电影、启发性的播客，

sentences.en: we believe that these will make us wiser, kinder, better people.
sentences.zh: 我们相信这些能让我们变得更睿智、更善良、更好。

sentences.en: The Chinese philosopher Lao Tzu is supposed to have said,
sentences.zh: 据说中国哲学家老子曾说过：

sentences.en: Watch your thoughts, they become your words.
sentences.zh: 注意你的思想，它们会变成你的言语。

sentences.en: Watch your words, they become your actions.
sentences.zh: 注意你的言语，它们会变成你的行动。

sentences.en: Watch your actions, they become your habits.
sentences.zh: 注意你的行动，它们会变成你的习惯。

sentences.en: Watch your habits, they become your character.
sentences.zh: 注意你的习惯，它们会变成你的性格。

sentences.en: Watch your character, it becomes your destiny.
sentences.zh: 注意你的性格，它会变成你的命运。

sentences.en: By this logic, if we want to be good, kind, and ethical people,
sentences.zh: 按照这个逻辑，如果我们想成为善良、仁慈且有道德的人，

sentences.en: we should watch movies about good people, read books about kindness,
sentences.zh: 我们就应该看关于好人的电影，读关于善良的书，

sentences.en: and consume stories about high-minded individuals who always do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 并接触那些总是做正确之事的崇高人物的故事。

sentences.en: Glance at any list of bestsellers or movies that crush at the box office,
sentences.zh: 看看任何畅销书榜单或票房大卖的电影，

sentences.en: and you don't see many high-minded plots and altruistic characters.
sentences.zh: 你却看不到多少崇高的情节和利他的人物。

sentences.en: Now, you find people who lie and cheat,
sentences.zh: 相反，你看到的是撒谎和欺骗的人，

sentences.en: family members who betray one another,
friends who are not good friends.
If we are what we consume, surely this does not bode well for us.
sentences.zh: 如果我们吃什么就是什么，那这肯定不是什么好兆头。

sentences.en: Nowhere is this tension more acute than in stories of violence, gore, and killing,
sentences.zh: 这种张力在暴力、血腥和杀戮的故事中表现得最为尖锐，

sentences.en: The goal of all the spattered blood, severed limbs, and blood-curdling shrieks
sentences.zh: 所有那些飞溅的鲜血、断裂的肢体和令人毛骨悚然的尖叫，

sentences.en: is to make you horrified, not edified.
sentences.zh: 目的都是为了让你感到恐惧，而非受到教化。

sentences.en: If most of us want to be good people,
sentences.zh: 如果大多数人都想成为好人，

sentences.en: what explains the enduring popularity of books and movies
sentences.zh: 那该如何解释那些书籍和电影为何经久不衰，

sentences.en: that show us not just the worst of human nature,
sentences.zh: 它们展示的不仅是人性中最糟糕的一面，

sentences.en: but the worst that the human imagination can conjure?
sentences.zh: 更是人类想象力所能构想出的最恶劣的情景？

sentences.en: and in a companion episode for Hidden Brain Plus,
sentences.zh: 以及《Hidden Brain Plus》的配套剧集中，

sentences.en: why we crane our necks to observe car crashes,
